title: build list never lists a draft (an invalid one is a warning on stderr); build list --drafts lists every draft with its origin, whether a saved build shadows it and why it is invalid
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). Drafts are not launchable builds, so the default list leaves them out and the dispatcher catalog never offers them. A draft that is invalid for this project is skipped with `jitso: warning: skipped build draft <path>: <problems>` on stderr (a draft shadowed by a saved build is silent). `--drafts` prints only drafts, one line per draft file by file name: the summary line, then ` (draft .jitso/drafts/<file>)`, then ` shadowed by <layer> <path>` when a saved build has its id, then ` invalid here: <problems>` when it is invalid; an empty folder prints one empty line like the default list. Any other argument is `JITSO REJECTED: unknown argument "<x>"`. The oracle's `presets list` knows no drafts and no flag: it prints the launchable presets and nothing on stderr, so the warning and the `--drafts` output FAIL on it.
